fields.Name: Predictive Studio Prediction Retention
fields.Description: The daily Predictive Studio prediction maintenance. First the binding backfill: every MJ: ML Model Scoring Bindings row with no ViewAuthorizationID (the pre-change bindings the PR 4 migration reshaped) gets the seeded "View Model Predictions" authorization, looked up by name; while that authorization is not loaded nothing changes and the next run retries. Then the retention sweep: for every binding with a RetentionDays, active or withdrawn, its Source = 'Model' Feature Values with an EffectiveAsOf more than RetentionDays days before the run's UTC day are deleted through the entity layer, 1,000 per batch (Record Changes records each). It never deletes a binding, model or pipeline. The per-binding counts go to the job run's Details. No configuration.
